title: The Springer Geometry of Specht Polynomials and Schubert cycle positivity for two row Springer fiber components
summary: We show that the type A Springer representation is realized geometrically in the homology of the complete flag variety by Specht polynomials. For any partition, we identify the classical Specht polynomial generators of the Specht module with the classes of a family of disjoint Levi--Richardson varieties, and this family degenerates to the corresponding Springer fiber. This factors Springer's Schubert positivity problem for Springer fiber components through a chain of positive expansions, from Specht polynomials through the Joseph polynomials to the Schubert cycles.
